name: download_file
description: Downloads a file, image, video, or binary document from a remote URL (e.g. found via browse_url or web_search) and saves it to disk inside the workspace.

url.description: The full remote URL of the file or media to download (e.g. https://example.com/images/diagram.png).

path.description: The relative save path inside the workspace (e.g. 'downloads/diagram.png' or 'media/intro.mp4'). If omitted, it's saved automatically in the 'downloads/' folder under a name derived from the URL.
